calibration.rule: single default profile for every eligible materialized NPC without a persisted body row; no actor-specific variants
limits: 100/80/70 is a D71 gameplay calibration proposal, not a historical or medical claim
the first-playable 100/80/70 profile is only an analogical anchor scoped to its candidate boatman
approval-7 authorizes current-state qualitative descriptions only and explicitly excludes initialization and initial metrics
the existing energy/endurance formula is not used; no body metric is derived from actor attributes, identity, occupation, profile_level, name, or appearance
values and calibration metadata stay internal and are not model input or player-facing prose

selection_rule.eligible_subject: materialized NPC with an authoritative body-state readback that confirms no persisted party_actor_body_states row
selection_rule.selected_profile: this single default profile, independent of actor attributes and identity
selection_rule.existing_body_profile_ref: not used as a selector in this candidate: its current rus.body_state.profile.v1 / values contract is not the target initialization_profile.v1 / initial_state DTO; use requires a separately approved owner mapping
selection_rule.readback_error: typed gap for this actor; never treated as row absence
selection_rule.persisted_row: preserve and use the existing row; never overwrite or reinitialize
selection_rule.emission: no owner initializer DTO is emitted until body-state owner and independent D67 approval cover this exact profile version
